title: campaign.compiled
description: PAYLOAD of the `campaign.compiled` envelope. Topic: campaign.lifecycle.compiled. Emitted by the campaign-compiler (§10.1) after it turns the MediaPlan into EXACT platform payloads (Meta MAPI v25+ shapes ⚠VERIFY-LIVE) and produces a dry-run diff. This event references the compiled payloads + the dry-run diff that gets attached to the approval card. NOTHING is live yet — launch only happens after a SIGNED ActionPlan (P4).

compiled_campaign_id.description: Id of this compiled campaign artifact (the bundle of exact platform payloads).

media_plan_ref.description: The media_plan_id this was compiled from (§10.1).

platform.description: Target ad platform for this compiled bundle (one event per platform). Phase-1 = meta.

dry_run_ref.description: Pointer to the dry-run diff (exact JSON payloads) attached to the approval card (§10.1).

destination.description: Primary destination type for this bundle (§10.1). CTWA opens the free 72h WA window (§11.2).

structure.description: Shape of the compiled tree (consolidation > fragmentation §10.1).

budget_floor_check.description: Per ad set budget floor verification (>=5x target CPqL daily for learning-exit feasibility §10.1/§23).

creative_refs.description: DAM asset ids that fill the creative slots (must be QA-passed before launch §15.4).

tracking.description: Tracking params baked into the payloads (mandatory for journey truth §8.1).

click_id_capture.description: Whether click-ID capture (fbclid/gclid/ctwa_clid) is wired for this destination — mandatory (§8.1).

requires_approval.description: Always true for a launch in Phase 1 (training wheels §21). Launch path = signed ActionPlan only.
